title: Filter parameter sweep
text: Every filter at several quality, distance, strength, angle and alpha settings, on a live vector shape (the renderer's own filter path) and through BitmapData.applyFilter (the software path), each against AIR. 43 cases on four pages of a 1290 x 930 window.
notes: Mean channel difference per 160 x 160 cell, 0 to 255: filters that match AIR sit at 0.0 to 0.7, a visibly wrong one at 8 to 17, so the limit is 1.0.
